summary: Wynn Resorts filed an 8-K reporting Q1 2026 results (Items 2.02/7.01) and a dividend declaration (Item 8.01). Operating revenues were $1.86B, net income $120.5M ($1.04 diluted EPS), Adjusted Property EBITDAR $562.4M. A cash dividend of $0.25/share was declared, payable May 29 to holders of record May 18. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event is present. The filing is a routine earnings release with a standard quarterly dividend.
